cases.why: the pull-request trigger gets a path filter again, so a change to documentation or a workflow skips the very tests that read it (the 2026-09-28 audit's finding)
the push trigger no longer names main, so documentation committed straight to main is never tested
the job installs whatever pytest is newest instead of requirements-dev.txt's pin, so the version that checked one PR and the next can differ with nothing recording it
node is not installed, so every test that runs template code in node skips green instead of running
